enable_debug_mode: enable PyMJCF debug mode to log stack traces when MJCF objects are modified
disable_debug_mode: disable PyMJCF debug mode to stop logging stack traces during MJCF object modifications
get_current_stack_trace: get the current execution stack trace truncated to before PyMJCF internal code
freeze_current_stack_trace: use the freeze_current_stack_trace context manager to speed up bulk operations in debug mode
dump_full_debug_info_to_disk: dump full debug information including XML and stack traces to a specified directory on disk
